summary: First full pass on UnderScope (backend + frontend). Backend: 25 pytest cases across companies/market/compare/assistant-SSE — 24 passed, 1 failed exposing a real SSE framing defect. Frontend: Home, 9 sidebar nav routes, global search (click + Ctrl+K), company page (8 tabs, chart, watchlist toggle), Watchlist add/remove, Compare add/remove + min-2 enforcement, Scenario Lab sliders, and AI assistant streaming were all exercised end-to-end. Core journeys work; the AI assistant answer text is corrupted in the UI due to unescaped newlines in SSE data frames.

critical.issue:
SSE frames are emitted as `data: {ev.content}` without escaping newlines. Any delta containing 
 or 

 breaks the frame: content after the newline arrives as a line with no `data:` prefix and is silently dropped by the client (also creates spurious frame boundaries). Verified with test_assistant_multiline_integrity (2 orphan frames of 11) AND visually in the UI: NVDA answer rendered as '## Biggest Structural Dependencies — Ranked by CriticalityL) — FACT, highest near-term chokepoint**ifically for Blackwell's...' i.e. words/lines lost and all markdown structure flattened. Fix: JSON-encode the payload, e.g. `yield 'data: ' + json.dumps({'t': ev.content}) + '

'` and JSON.parse in streamAssistant (src/lib/api.js), or escape 
 -> \n on send and unescape on receive.

minor.issue: No timeout/ownership guard on the LLM stream and no persistence of Q&A; also `logger` is referenced inside event_gen but defined at module bottom (works, but fragile ordering).
Unknown ticker returns 200 with empty items instead of 404 (inconsistent with /companies/{ticker} and /price-history which 404).

ui_bugs.issue: Assistant answers display corrupted/incomplete text (root cause = backend SSE newline framing above). Additionally the raw markdown (##, **) is rendered as plain text with whitespace-pre-wrap — no markdown renderer, so even correct output looks unpolished.
'Ask Analyst' global button is `hidden md:inline-flex`, so on mobile (390px) there is no way to open the assistant outside a company page.

React console error on /compare: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option> ... will cause a hydration error' from the native <select>/<option> in Compare.jsx (~line 76-80). Functionally works but pollutes console.
Discover.jsx simply re-renders Home (`return <Home />`) — nav item is a duplicate view with no discover-specific filtering/sector browse.

integration_issues.flow: AI Assistant streaming (Ask Analyst -> suggestion -> stream)
integration_issues.issue: Streaming works and tokens arrive progressively (length samples 1->58->330->...->2819, done event received, no error marker), but aggregated text is lossy/mangled because of the SSE framing defect. Follow-up question via textarea + Ask also streamed correctly (617 chars).

issues: Nodes were plain <details> with no data-testid (added by tester). Label says 'Click a node to inspect the relationship' but nodes look non-interactive (no cursor/affordance beyond the arrow).
Large empty right/bottom area — pages feel sparse at 1920px; Scenario Lab affected-companies panel shows only one card until sliders move.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix SSE data framing in /api/assistant/ask — JSON-encode each delta (json.dumps) and decode in streamAssistant; currently answer text is lost whenever the model emits newlines.
Render assistant output as markdown (e.g. react-markdown) instead of raw pre-wrap text.
Make 'Ask Analyst' reachable on mobile viewports.
Give Discover its own view (sector/filter/theme browse) instead of re-rendering Home.
Fix <option> child DOM-nesting React error on /compare.
Return 404 for unknown tickers on /news and /events for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py — assistant Q&A is never persisted to Mongo despite an active motor client; DB is effectively unused (fine for demo, but dead dependency).
Company.jsx is 392 lines with 8 tab components inline; consider splitting per-tab components into files as it grows.
AssistantPanel: onError overwrites the whole streamed message with the error text, discarding partial content already received.
seed_data_creation: None — app is public/demo data only. LocalStorage watchlist entries created and cleaned up during testing.
test_credentials: N/A — app is public, no auth. /app/memory/test_credentials.md not required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env). test_assistant_multiline_integrity is the regression test for the SSE newline bug — it must pass after the fix, and also re-verify in UI that the NVDA answer keeps its markdown line breaks. Verified working: all /api/companies/* endpoints for all 24 tickers, market overview/trending/signals, compare 2-4 with 400/404/422 edge cases, 9 nav routes, global search + Ctrl+K, 8 company tabs, watchlist add/remove via LocalStorage, compare add/remove with min-2 disabled button, scenario lab + company scenario sliders recomputing impact, dependency accordion expansion, footer disclaimer, no mobile horizontal overflow.
rca_of_the_issue:
Root cause of the assistant text corruption: FastAPI handler streams raw model deltas into the SSE `data:` field without escaping. SSE treats 
 as a field separator and 

 as an event terminator, so any newline inside a delta splits the frame; the frontend parser in src/lib/api.js only accumulates lines prefixed with `data:`, so the remainder is discarded. Reproduce: curl -N POST /api/assistant/ask with a question that elicits bullet lists, then split the raw body on 

 — frames without a data:/event: prefix are the lost text.
